subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Seismographs record vibrations in Earth's crust to help scientists study earthquakes and the planet's interior structure.
• Before electronic instruments, readings at geophysical observatories were recorded by resident scientists.
• Caroline Renault was the resident seismologist at the Puy de Dome Observatory in France.
• She held this position from 1871 to 1889.
• Pavel Elliott was the resident seismologist at the Uccle Observatory in Belgium.
• He held this position from 1932 to 1948.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference between the two seismologists. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Caroline Renault and Pavel Elliott both played important roles in recording seismic activity at European observatories.
choices.B: As the resident seismologist at the Uccle Observatory, Pavel Elliott recorded vibrations in Earth's crust.
choices.C: Caroline Renault worked as a resident seismologist in an earlier century than did Pavel Elliott.
choices.D: From 1871 to 1889, seismic activity in France was documented thanks to the work of Caroline Renault.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a difference between the two seismologists, noting that Caroline Renault (who worked from 1871 to 1889) worked in an earlier century than Pavel Elliott (who worked from 1932 to 1948).

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence describes Pavel Elliott's role as a resident seismologist; it doesn't emphasize a difference between the two seismologists.
